# v0.51 Canonical Relation IDs / Multi-valued Structural Closure

This benchmark derives deterministic facet-relation IDs from `(relation family, object ID)` without domain labels in Forge. It then rebuilds structural closure and recursive macros over the faceted numeric graph. The DB-free runtime must enumerate every inherited PROPERTY/ACTION value for the frozen teacher fixture, preserve teacher-off execution, and recover safe macro routing that v0.50 could not emit under coarse scalar predicates.

Run:

```bash
eqforge-relation-facets --out out/v0_51_relation_facets
```
